structural_rules: model_id must resolve to exactly one canonical CatalogEntry.entry_id.
decode_fingerprint must be lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256.
enabled=true requires non-empty approved_by and approved_at_ms and requires disabled_reason=null.
A disabled row remains structurally loadable and re-certification cannot enable it.
Approval rows contain no machine profile, numeric profile, processing, runtime, worker-path, concrete evidence, or G-DEC fields.
An enabled approval with no evidence may load structurally but cannot satisfy the serve-time predicate.

semantic_digest.encoding: each value is unsigned 64-bit big-endian byte length followed by canonical UTF-8 bytes; null is eight 0xff bytes with no payload
semantic_digest.integers: unsigned base 10 with no leading zeroes
semantic_digest.revision_rule: every schema revision uses a distinct separator and cannot share the v1 separator

load_and_serve.recomputed_digest: does not excuse structural or semantic invalidity

every_mutation: semantic_digest recomputed in the same transaction
mutation_contract.individual_rollback: disable exactly (model_id, decode_fingerprint) with a non-empty reason
mutation_contract.emergency_rollback: disable every owned-decode approval atomically with the supplied reason
